data.name: Ariv
data.gender_notes: Ariv is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Tamil mythology, Ariv is derived from Arisudan, a warrior king who had an insatiable desire for victory. The name Ariv signifies one's deep longing and unwavering determination towards achieving their goals. The name Ariv carries the meaning “Desire, Longing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ariv usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, longing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ariv is a name that symbolizes the inner flame of desire and determination, inspiring one to pursue their dreams with unyielding focus and passion.
data.etymology: Ariv belongs to the Tamil linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Longing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ariv total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
